en.p: For the set $X=\{x\mid x \text{ is a natural number at most } 10\}$, find the number of functions $f:X\to X$ satisfying the following conditions. [4 points]

box: (A) For every natural number $x$ at most 9, $f(x)\le f(x+1)$.
(B) When $1\le x\le 5$, $f(x)\le x$; when $6\le x\le 10$, $f(x)\ge x$.
